propositions: Handheld frontier exclusion lists (stating already-searched paths and patterns) are rendered inert by the untrusted fence design, offering no measurable reduction in re-search overlap on resume attempts.

Frontier blocks function as signposts rather than suppressors, causing resumption verifiers to immediately re-read and re-examine evidence locations listed in the block, paradoxically increasing overlap rate.

Cache seeding via verdict crediting already removes the dominant redundancy (re-proving credited criteria); remaining re-grounding of unproven criteria cannot be suppressed by data-shaped exclusion lists within untrusted fences.

On both test tickets (45c1 and 8d74), the treatment arm (frontier-augmented) achieved overlap increases of +78% and +60% respectively, both failing the predeclared >=30% reduction threshold required for GO decision.
